class.name: LimbMap
class.brief_description: Skeleton hierarchy, reference-pose and skin-weight queries.
class.description: Initialize with a Skeleton3D and optional MeshInstance3D. Limb queries include the requested root and descendants. Named and indexed Skin binds and four/eight influences are supported. Limb weight queries use the maximum individual bone influence, following the reference plugin. The historical get_all_immediate_bones query returns the complement of a subtree.

members.member: Case-insensitive text fragments used to omit matching bone names from filtered hierarchy queries. A queried limb still includes its root bone.
Read-only count of vertices across all surfaces of the initialized mesh. Returns zero when no mesh is available.
